subsystem.name: MathAndCollision
subsystem.responsibility: Stateless geometry/vector math primitives (ray-sphere intersection, 2D direction projection, SSE two-point interpolation), a collision-geometry container owning strut and struct arrays with nearest-neighbor queries and destructor teardown, and two standalone global-workspace sparse-matrix LDLT constraint solvers.

source_proposals.summary: The math_and_collision scope contains three groups. (1) CollisionPrimitives: stateless math helpers - a ray-sphere quadratic intersection test feeding the vehicle suspension force calculation (0x00401180), a 2D direction projection (0x00423AD0) used in AI/opponent proximity, and an SSE two-point linear interpolation (0x0051F6A0). (2) CollisionModel: a collision-geometry container owning a 316-byte-stride strut array (+0x134, count +0x130), a 28-byte-stride struct array (+0x154) and further buffers (+0x150/+0x158); it supports nearest-neighbor queries over linked nodes and struts (0x00403640), indexed struct copies (0x00403F70), and a destructor-style teardown (0x004045F0) freeing every owned allocation. (3) SparseConstraintSolver: two standalone block LDL^T factorization and substitution-solve kernels (0x0056FA96, 0x00575BBD) operating on global double constraint-matrix workspaces and row-pointer tables, returning 0. All owners are UNKNOWN at the function-IR level; the classes above are DERIVED/GUESS proposals.

function_roles.role: Ray-sphere quadratic intersection test on six double inputs; returns 1/sqrt(p) penetration-length proxy or 0.0 on any miss; used by the vehicle suspension force calculation

Nearest-neighbor spatial query over linked collision nodes (next at +0x110/+0x10C) and the 316-byte-stride strut array (this+0x134, count this+0x130), gated by a signed plane-distance probe; returns closest qualifying node or plane-verified candidate
Read getter: copies two 12-byte (3-dword) blocks out of element a2 of the 28-byte-stride struct array at this+0x154 into a3/a4 and returns a4; called from AI-driver and proximity paths

Destructor-style teardown: frees the three owned buffers (+0x150/+0x154/+0x158), nulls them and writes -1.0f at +0x148, walks the 316-byte-stride element array (+0x134, count from length prefix at base-4) calling per-element release, frees the array allocation, resets +0x130/+0x134/+0x138, returns prior array base; called from Game_Post
2D scalar projection of vector a2 onto vector a1 (components x at +0x0, z at +0x8): dot(a1,a2)/dot(a1,a1), returning 0.0 for a zero-length a1; AI/opponent proximity context
SSE two-point linear interpolation helper: a1 = a2 + (a3-a2)*a5 + (a4-a2)*a6 on packed two-point vectors (high halves only), storing result into a1 and returning a1

Block LDL^T factorization of a sparse dynamics constraint matrix plus substitution solve, carried out entirely on global double workspaces (factor blocks 0x008CFBF0-0x008CFC28 area, diagonals/accumulators 0x008D3A28-0x008D3B60, row blocks via pointer tables 0x008D3988-0x008D3A24); no callees, returns 0

Block-structured LDL^T factorization (symmetric-indefinite Cholesky variant) of a global double constraint matrix 0x008D2120..0x008D3978 driven by row-pointer array 0x008D3B68..0x008D3BF0; reciprocal-diagonal pivots, L-column scaling, Schur rank-1 updates, RHS forward elimination and back-substitution writing the final solve entry to 0x008D3870; no parameters, returns 0

class_proposals.name: CollisionPrimitives
class_proposals.responsibility: Stateless geometric/vector math primitives: ray-sphere quadratic intersection (suspension contact), 2D direction projection, and SSE two-point linear interpolation. No instance fields, no callees; grouped by shape only (owner identity not proven by the packet).

class_proposals.name: CollisionModel
class_proposals.responsibility: Container object owning the collision geometry arrays: a 316-byte-stride element (strut) array at +0x134 with count at +0x130, a 28-byte-stride struct array at +0x154, and further owned buffers at +0x150/+0x158. Supports nearest-neighbor queries over linked nodes and struts, indexed struct reads, and a destructor-style teardown freeing every owned allocation. Name is descriptive; packet reports owner UNKNOWN.

class_proposals.name: SparseConstraintSolver
class_proposals.responsibility: Standalone numeric kernel: block LDL^T factorization and substitution solve of sparse dynamics constraint matrices stored in global double workspaces (0x008CFBF0..0x008D3B60 and 0x008D2120..0x008D3978) indexed by global row-pointer arrays. No parameters, no callees, returns 0. Two independent functions grouped by shared algorithm and overlapping global workspace region.

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionRaySphereContact
compatibility_contracts.description: Ray-sphere quadratic intersection used by the vehicle suspension force calculation: takes six doubles, returns 0.0 on any miss and 1/sqrt(p) as a penetration-length proxy on hit. Must remain a pure scalar float-returning function with no side effects or callees.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionModelOwnedBufferLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The collision container owns pointer buffers at +0x150/+0x154/+0x158 and a 316-byte-stride element array at +0x134 (count +0x130) whose allocation is length-prefixed 4 bytes before the base. Teardown frees each non-null buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf, runs per-element release (0x004B0170) over the element array, frees the array allocation, nulls the pointers, writes -1.0f at +0x148, clears +0x130/+0x134/+0x138, and returns the prior array base.

compatibility_contracts.name: NearestNeighborQueryResult
compatibility_contracts.description: Nearest-neighbor query walks linked collision nodes (next pointers at +0x110/+0x10C) and the strut array (316-byte stride, entries with type field at +0x12C <= 1 distance-tested), using a signed plane-distance probe (0x004FB6D0). Returns a node pointer, preferring the plane-verified candidate when its final signed distance is non-negative.

compatibility_contracts.name: SparseConstraintSolverWorkspace
compatibility_contracts.description: Two standalone LDLT solvers factor global double constraint-matrix workspaces (0x008CFBF0..0x008D3B60 and 0x008D2120..0x008D3978) indexed by global row-pointer arrays (0x008D3988..0x008D3A24 and 0x008D3B68..0x008D3BF0); both take no parameters and return 0. A replacement must keep these global buffers and pointer tables byte-compatible.

subsystem.name: MathAndCollision
subsystem.responsibility: Spatial nearest-neighbor lookups (strut arrays, BVH chains, spatial trees), matrix/vector math helpers, compressed short-int vector codecs, and array initialization used by AI steering, per-frame vehicle physics, and audio parameter paths.

source_proposals.summary: Ten validated functions grouped into five proposed classes. Three spatial nearest-neighbor queries (0x004038E0 strut scan, 0x004039C0 BVH chain walk, 0x00403AA0 tree walk) share the node-field concepts (position +148/+152/+156, plane coefficients +164/+172, links +268/+272, identifier +300) and a common fallback path into 0x004038E0. Two pure matrix/vector helpers (0x00435E00 3x3xvector multiply, 0x00566E40 Euler-to-matrix) operate on a 3x3 row-major matrix block. Three compressed short-int vector codecs (0x004B2420, 0x004B2580, 0x004B2800) decode packed int16 records with documented scale factors (1/2048, 0.02, 1/512). One per-frame physics transform setup (0x004F17D0) copies a rotation matrix plus input vector and computes the product into a vehicle-physics frame buffer at base+0x34B0. One zero-init helper (0x004F2B10) clears 16-dword embedded array blocks. All owners are UnknownObject in the packet; every class grouping is a DERIVED proposal, not a confirmed source name.

function_roles.role: Nearest-strut query over a strut array (count at this+0x130, base this+0x134, stride 316) with strut-type filtering (a3 == -1 or element type at +300) and a plane-side rejection test (+164/+172 coefficients) that selects the linked collision child at +272; returns 0 when the count is 0.

Nearest-node traversal over a linked chain of physics nodes walking +272 child links while the accumulated path length (sum of node+60) stays below 200.0 (flt_59E470); descends on strictly smaller squared distance and early-outs otherwise; called by AISteering.

Spatial tree nearest-neighbor search walking +268 sibling and +272 child chains with identifier checks (+300); when no candidate survives or the optional plane test (a5) rejects it, falls back to SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest (0x004038E0); used by AI racing-line/steering callers.

Pure 3x3 matrix (nine doubles, row-major, this+0x0..0x40) by 3-vector multiply writing the product into a3; returns the input vector pointer a2; no branches, globals, or callees; used by physics solvers.

Unpack a compact vector record: copy three raw dwords from this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8 into a2, then convert three int16 values at this+0xC/+0xE/+0x10 to floats by 1/2048 (0.00048828125, flt_59E77C) into a3; returns a3; companion to the packing routine sub_4B2310.

Unpack three int16 values from this[15..17] (offsets 0x1E/0x20/0x22) into floats scaled by 0.02 (1/50, flt_59E6EC) writing to output float array a2; returns a2; inverse of the short-vector packing routine on the per-frame physics/audio path.

thiscall unpack of a compact 2-component int16 vector: zero a2+4 (Y), scale this[20] (offset 0x28) by 1/512 into a2 (X), scale this[21] (offset 0x2A) by 1/512 into a2+8 (Z); returns a2; per-frame decode for VehiclePhysicsTimeStep and AudioParameterInterpolation.

Copy a 3x3 rotation matrix (0x24 bytes) from a2 into this+0x34B0, copy a 3-component vector from a3 into this+0x3534..0x353C, compute the matrix-by-vector product into this+0x3540..0x3548 and return a pointer to the stored matrix (this+0x34B0); called per frame from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep.

Zero-initialize a 16-dword (0x40-byte) array this[0]..this[15] at offsets 0x0..0x3C and return the this pointer; no reads, globals, or callees; called from PhysicsDefaultsInitializer and TireModelDataInit to zero embedded 16-element arrays.
Convert three Euler angles in a1[0..2] into a row-major 3x3 rotation matrix written to a2[0..8]; pure trigonometric computation with no side effects and no callees.

class_proposals.name: SpatialNearestNeighborQuery
class_proposals.responsibility: Nearest-neighbor lookups over spatial strut arrays, BVH node chains, and spatial trees used by AI steering / racing-line code. Shared node concepts (position, plane coefficients, links, identifier) appear across all three methods, but common ownership of the query fields is not proven.

class_proposals.name: MatrixVectorHelpers
class_proposals.responsibility: Pure matrix/vector math: 3x3 matrix by vector multiply (doubles) and Euler-angle to rotation-matrix conversion (floats). The shared offsets may hold different element widths; grouping is a DERIVED proposal, not proven common storage.

class_proposals.name: PackedShortVectorRecord
class_proposals.responsibility: Compressed int16 vector codecs: unpack compact records into floats with documented scales (1/2048, 0.02, 1/512). The three methods read different record layouts; grouping is DERIVED and common ownership of one record struct is unproven.

class_proposals.name: PhysicsFrameTransform
class_proposals.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics transform setup: store a 3x3 rotation matrix, an input vector, and their matrix-by-vector product in a frame buffer at base+0x34B0, returning a pointer to the stored matrix.

class_proposals.name: EmbeddedArrayBlock
class_proposals.responsibility: Zero-initialized 16-dword embedded array block inside larger construction objects (physics defaults, tire model data).

interfaces.name: ISpatialQuery
interfaces.purpose: Nearest-node / nearest-strut spatial lookup used by AI steering and racing-line code, with optional strut-type filtering and plane-side rejection.

interfaces.name: ICompressedVectorCodec
interfaces.purpose: Decode compact int16-packed position/direction records into float vectors on the per-frame physics and audio paths.

compatibility_contracts.name: NearestNeighborQuerySemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Nearest-neighbor lookups must preserve the documented selection rules: zero-count early return (strut count at base+0x130 <= 0), strut-type filter (a3 == -1 or equals element type at +300), plane-side rejection selecting the linked +272 child, and the 200.0 accumulated path-length bound for chain traversal.

compatibility_contracts.name: ShortVectorPackingScale
compatibility_contracts.description: Compressed int16 vectors must decode with the packet's documented scale factors: 1/2048 for the 3-dword + 3-int16 record, 0.02 for the this[15..17] record, and 1/512 for the 2-component this[20]/this[21] record with the Y output component zeroed.

compatibility_contracts.name: MatrixVectorMultiplyReturnsInput
compatibility_contracts.description: The 3x3-by-vector multiply must return the input vector pointer; the Euler conversion must produce a row-major 3x3 rotation matrix with no side effects; MatrixVectorSetup must return a pointer to the stored matrix.
